cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You apologised for missing my concert. What do you think the empty seat felt like?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I know the timetable. I'm asking about the seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You felt let down. I watched the recording this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you saw me look at the door before the encore. Can you understand how it felt to keep expecting you?

mechanism: A corrects factual explanations into evidence of emotional impact, using exact moments in a concert recording to make B acknowledge the cost of waiting.
confusable: D03 seeks apology; D75 specifically seeks acknowledgment of felt cost beyond the missed event or its cause.
comparison: Silence alternative distinguishes broken device from felt abandonment; concert alternative uses a witnessed door glance to deepen let-down acknowledgement.
seedUse: Missed concert, cancelled train, empty seat and encore recording derive from D75-a; S03 adds precise event-versus-effect correction.
